description: App Store Connect sales for one of your own iOS apps: daily first-time downloads, redownloads, in-app purchase units and approximate USD proceeds (`proceeds_usd_approx`, converted with a static FX table — present it as approximate), window totals, and a per-country breakdown sorted by downloads. Same numbers as the Performance page. iOS only. Requires the Agency plan (403 on other plans) AND an App Store Connect connection at /settings/connections. Always check `status`: anything other than `ready` (not_connected, not_ios, app_not_in_account, pending, key_lacks_analytics) means there's no data and `message` says how to fix it — never read an empty series as zero. Days Apple hasn't reported yet have `reported: false` and null metrics.

app_id.description: Sonar app UUID of one of your own tracked iOS apps — the `id` returned by sonar_list_apps or sonar_create_product. The app's store id (bundle id) also works; pass `store` if it exists in both stores.

days.description: Window length in days (1-366) when `start` is omitted. Default 30.

end.description: Last day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Default yesterday (UTC) — Apple posts a day the next morning at the earliest.

start.description: First day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Omit to count `days` back from `end`.

store.description: Only needed when `app_id` is a store id tracked in both stores. App Store Connect data is iOS-only.

name: sonar_app_sales
title: App Sales (App Store Connect)
